leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a custom hook function signature with TypeScript generics to create a reusable RBAC permission utility
Implement a permissions object structure with TypeScript interfaces to represent role-based access rules
Apply conditional logic to check if a user's role exists within the defined permissions object
Utilize array methods to verify if a user has access to specific actions within their role
Construct a hook return object with boolean values indicating permission status for different actions
Execute the custom hook within a React component to access permission checking functionality
Use TypeScript type safety to ensure proper parameter types when invoking the permission hook
Handle edge cases by implementing fallback logic for undefined roles or missing permissions
Return structured permission data from the hook for consumption by UI components
Apply the permission hook to conditionally render UI elements based on user access rights
Modify permission rules by updating the permissions object structure without changing component logic
